# What does this book keep exclusive versus wide?

> See what a Kindle book keeps on KDP exclusive (paid sales plus Kindle Unlimited page reads) versus going wide. Paperback print cost, 70% vs 35% ebook, and Ingram wholesale are boxes you type from your own dashboard. Free, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
